name: flashslot
description: Real-time flash-deal marketplace for last-minute slots with auto-dropping prices and exactly-once selling.

scripts.local:setup: npm run local:start && sh scripts/with-local-env.sh npm run db:deploy -w apps/api && sh scripts/with-local-env.sh npm run seed -w apps/api
scripts.local: npm run local:start && sh scripts/with-local-env.sh npm run dev
scripts.local:seed: sh scripts/with-local-env.sh npm run seed -w apps/api
scripts.docker:setup: npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.docker: npm run infra:up && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.stack:seed: docker compose exec api1 node dist/seed.js
